trace.cypher: MATCH (t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t) WHERE o.name = 'William Chisholm' RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team

MATCH (t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t) WHERE o.name CONTAINS 'William Chisholm' RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team

MATCH (t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t) WHERE regexp_matches(o.name, '(?i).*william.*chisholm.*') RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t:Team) WHERE o.name CONTAINS 'Chisholm' RETURN t.founded_year AS col1, o.name AS col2, t.team_name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
